text:
elaine: quick check — hitting a client bug in payments where our SDK chokes on responses from /v1/generate when response has structured output + optional fields. Client expects Content-Type header and stable null behavior. anyone familiar with current contract? (cc @sam)

ben: I think we recently adjusted content-type for ndjson streaming but JSON endpoints should still be `application/json`. Which endpoint param are you using?

elaine: using model=redwood-structured, &format=structured (internal flag). sample failing response:
```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/plain
Body: {"items": [{"id":"abc","score":1.0,"meta":null}]}
```
SDK tries to parse as JSON only when header contains `application/json`, so it treats body as string and fails.

sam: oof. That sounds like regressed header mapping. I recall a change to avoid forcing content-type on some internal proxies. @maria any idea? PR #3456 touched response mime mapping.

maria: yeah I touched that. The proxy sometimes strips `application/json` when we return `text/event-stream` or when streaming fallback toggles. For structured non-stream responses we should set `application/json; charset=utf-8`. I'll push a fix to the proxy config.

ben: Also need to confirm null-vs-absent semantics for `meta`. Client wants `meta` present and explicitly `null` for compatibility. Can we ensure serializer includes keys even when null?

elaine: yes, embedding versioning relies on presence. That was our compatibility promise. If serializer omits field we have to bump SDK. But prefer to keep present.

maria: I'll update serializer to always include keys per schema when field is optional but defined in contract. Will add a unit test to check `json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(\",\",\":\"))` plus a schema check.

sam: pinging infra: can we also add a lightweight smoke test in CI that verifies `Content-Type` for a basic `structured` request? minimal curl in e2e job.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: proxy-config-fix (maria) -> staging (ETA 10m) :rocket:

elaine: thanks — once staged I'll run the SDK repro and post results. If green I'll make a quick patch release and tag @frontend-team for the SDK bump. :+1:
